messages.author: 8dbb28b015bb7762
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Add INLA to CRAN Bayesian Task View.
parts:
There are a number of CRAN packages that depend on other programs/libraries to be installed (without compilation) [1].

Perhaps it would be feasible to separate R-INLA  from INLA following (some of) those examples, so it can be put into CRAN?

ƒacu.-

[1] See the thread in R-pkg-devel https://stat.ethz.ch/pipermail/r-package-devel/2016q1/000652.html, and also see packages RJAGS (installs external JAGS program), Rblapi (downloads a free library for which no sources are available), rsatscan (uses a free but not open source external program), asremlplus (uses a external commercial program).
